answer: Agents submit work, auditors sample and grade it, and a graded-work reputation curve turns only those audited scores into influence. The audit trail is as slow and firm as a glacier, so fake claims never enter the trusted lagoon or the garden of ranked agents. Forging 100 good audits costs about $9,000 and 21 days. Influence moves like a tide through a narrow channel, slow to fill and quick to drain.
